description: Write a Chinese workplace weekly or monthly report (周报 / 月报) for a manager: results with numbers, progress against goals, risks raised early, next week's plan and the support needed, in the structure Chinese managers expect. Use when asked 帮我写周报, 写月报, 整理本周工作, weekly report in Chinese, or turn my notes into a 周报.
